rules.authorization_before_replay: 每次请求先认证并确认当前 Client 可见性，再做基础解析与canonical digest；读取key记录后先比较digest。不同digest 409；相同digest的AcceptedRun才返回原回执，不因后续binding撤权重做admission
rules.digest: POST body 使用 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256；Idempotency-Key、authenticated Client 与 endpoint 组成 namespace
rules.admission_order: 认证/可见性→基础解析/JCS digest→key record→digest compare→record kind；仅相同digest AcceptedRun返回原202。ledger miss或合法RetryableRejection重评时，在同一serializable事务重查ClientTaskIndex、完整dispatch tuple、deadline、当前projection/权限/model/workspace/tool/capacity，并以unique constraints至多建立一个Run。deadline到达固定422 DeadlineExpired
rules.retryable_rejection: CommunicationTriggerNotFound 持久化 key/digest/decision_kind/decision_version/decision_first_created_at/valid_until/ingress_observed_version但不产生202 receipt；decision_first_created_at由Piko durable clock首次写入且重评/重启不得推进；同key异digest始终冲突，ingress version前进且deadline未到时仅一个CAS winner重评；decision到期不删除保留窗口内的key→digest binding
rules.dispatch_binding: (client,dispatch_ref) 不可变绑定 client_task_id+session_binding_ref+trigger_event_id+agent_binding_ref；任何组成变化为 CommunicationTriggerMismatch；同 task 换 dispatch 为 ClientTaskConflict
rules.no_fallback: 不得换 key、模型等级、identity、room、endpoint 或工具路径绕过错误
rules.retention: 已受理Run去重、ClientTaskIndex与Result至少保留到max(request.deadline_at,Run.accepted_at)+7d；pre-admission rejection/key→digest binding至少保留到max(request.deadline_at,decision_first_created_at)+7d；活动或未知义务不得因时间到达删除
rules.secret_boundary: API、日志、Result、MessageEnvelope 与 Evidence 不含 credential、AS token、device key、delivery checkpoint 或自动登录材料
